Requirement: The system shall support the laboratory processes listed in the scope section (edit: labs, sites, sample types).
Notes: Example row. Replace with your own scope.

Requirement: The system shall allow configuration of sample types without code changes.
The system shall assign a unique sample ID at login.
The system shall print a barcode label containing the sample ID at login.
The system shall record sample receipt date, time, received-by user and condition on receipt.
The system shall record storage location and every change of location for each sample.
The system shall record retention, disposal date and the user who disposed of each sample.
The system shall hold specifications with version, effective date and approval status.
The system shall link each sample to the approved specification version in force at login.
The system shall prevent use of a specification version that is not approved.
The system shall generate worklists of pending tests by analyst or instrument.
The system shall compare each result with the specification limits and flag results outside them.
The system shall require an investigation reference before an out-of-specification result can be reviewed.
The system shall perform defined calculations and store the inputs used for each calculated result.
Notes: List calculations in the functional specification.

Requirement: The system shall record units for every numeric result.
The system shall prevent the user who entered a result from reviewing or approving the same result.
The system shall enforce the sequence entry then review then approval.
The system shall generate a certificate of analysis only from approved results.
The system shall require a unique user ID and password for every user.
The system shall restrict functions by role and record every change to user roles and access rights.
The system shall record in a secure audit trail the user, server date and time, record, field, old value, new value and reason for every create, change and delete of GxP data.
The system shall prevent any user, including administrators, from editing, deleting or disabling the audit trail for GxP data.
The system shall show the signer's printed name, date and time of signing and the meaning of the signature on every signed record.
The system shall link each electronic signature to the record version it applies to.
The system shall require the user ID and password at the time of signing.
Notes: Check behaviour for repeated signings in one session.

Requirement: The system shall use a synchronised server clock for all time stamps and record the time zone.
The system shall export records with their metadata and audit trail in human-readable and electronic form.
The system shall provide filters on the audit trail by record, user, date and action to support audit-trail review.
The system shall import results from the listed instruments or data systems with a link to the source data (edit: list instruments).
Notes: Confirm output format of each instrument during discovery.

Requirement: The system shall reject and log imported data that fails defined format or range checks.
The system shall support backup and restore of all data and audit trails to a test environment for verification.
The system shall automatically lock a session after a configurable period of inactivity.
The system shall meet the response times agreed in the performance test plan with the agreed data volume.
Notes: Define volumes and targets with IT.

Requirement: Migrated records shall keep their original values, units and approval history.
Archived records shall remain retrievable and readable for the defined retention period.
The supplier shall provide a configuration or design specification for the delivered system.
The supplier shall provide user and administrator training material.
